title: Native Haven Files is the correct app; withdraw Files-internal tabs; merge the Google Drive connection into it
owner_instructions: STOP working on the separate web Files surface as the target of the Drive goal; the correct Files app is the native Haven desktop Files (the browser surface shown in the owner's 17 November screenshot: Locations Files/Trash sidebar, Folders in Files, Name/Date/Type/Size list, New-edit and Open command bar).
Remove the Files-internal tab strip (the second row of Files tabs). Files supports no tabs of its own; instead files will be dragged between Haven tabs.

Merge the Google Drive changes (the deployed cloud/files-drive connector work) into that native Files app: Google Drive becomes an authorised remote provider location in Files, per the v3 specification module 'Files and ten organisational folder views' (local and authorised remote providers, provider-native operations, recoverable Trash).

Resume the goal (fully functioning Files with an actual Drive connection) in the correct environment: the native Haven development instance on the PC, following the v3 specification and the Interface Atlas figures files / files-grid / files-context / files-organisation.

applicable_requirements: V3-FILES-LAY-01 navigable locations, breadcrumbs, search, list/grid, selection, details/preview, genuine file operations, comfortable padding
V3-FILES-LAY-02/03 ten organisation types (Folder, Project, Sheet, Tree, Smart, Timeline, Pipeline, Catalogue, Stash, Matrix) with normal contents fallback
V3-FILES-FEA-05 Preview and Open in App resolve the real owning app
V3-FILES-PER-01 recheck access; missing/revoked/quota conditions offer safe recovery
figure rule: local availability and provider sync are separate statuses; a cloud outage does not block local folders
specification_authority.note: The owner states the v3 package predates the Google Drive connector request by about two weeks, so the connector itself is additional owner intent, not a contradiction.

implementation_decision.tab_withdrawal: FilesBrowser.cui row 0 (folder tabs), the new-tab and per-tab close controls, the 'Open in new tab' command and the tab-count status text are withdrawn. The folder-tab state machine remains temporarily so history/session code stays untouched while Haven-tab drag integration is designed.
implementation_decision.drive_provider: Google Drive is added as a Files location over the canonical HostedItemMetadata contract (FilesLocationKind.ConnectedCloud semantics): one-time PKCE OAuth sign-in through the app's existing browser-launch pattern (like Calendar/Mail), access refreshed from a profile-stored refresh token, and provider-native list/navigate/search/create/rename/trash/restore/download against the owner's real Drive. Credentials stay in the owner's private profile directory; nothing is committed.
implementation_decision.authentication_choice: A direct provider connection needs a Google OAuth desktop client id supplied by the owner (HAVEN_GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_ID environment variable or ~/.config/9to1/google-drive-client-id.txt). The deployed cloud Worker (9to1.uk) keeps serving the browser Files app; the native connection is provider-direct per the specification's provider-connections prerequisite.

status: Pinned before coding (owner messages of 17 November 2026, 17:52-17:59 UTC). Implementation landed the same evening; on-screen verification pending the owner's live session.
